Create exactly this record (and nothing else), replacing $patient with the resolved Patient reference, $prescriber with the Practitioner who is the requester of the MedicationRequest that the administration's request references, and $administration with the administration: {"resourceType": "Communication", "status": "completed", "subject": {"reference": "$patient"}, "recipient": [{"reference": "$prescriber"}], "about": [{"reference": "$administration"}]}. notified (boolean) is whether you created it.
